WITH fct_calls_1 AS (
  SELECT
    dim_cc_site.site_id AS site,
    dim_cc_site.site_name AS site_name,
    COUNT(
      DISTINCT IF(fct_calls.is_account_closure_call IS TRUE, fct_calls.conversation_id, NULL)
    ) AS closure_calls
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls` AS fct_calls
  LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` AS dim_cc_site
    ON dim_cc_site.site_id = fct_calls.site_id
  WHERE
    (
      fct_calls.conversation_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    )
    AND (
      fct_calls.conversation_date <= CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
), fct_cc_site_cost_monthly_2 AS (
  SELECT
    dim_cc_site.site_id AS site,
    dim_cc_site.site_name AS site_name,
    SUM(fct_cc_site_cost_monthly.total_expense) AS total_cost
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_cc_site_cost_monthly` AS fct_cc_site_cost_monthly
  JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` AS dim_cc_site
    ON dim_cc_site.site_id = fct_cc_site_cost_monthly.site_id
  WHERE
    (
      fct_cc_site_cost_monthly.month_start >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    )
    AND (
      fct_cc_site_cost_monthly.month_start <= CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
)
SELECT
  site,
  site_name,
  closure_calls AS closure_calls,
  total_cost AS total_cost
FROM fct_calls_1
FULL JOIN fct_cc_site_cost_monthly_2
  USING (site, site_name)
ORDER BY

SELECT
  dim_account.product_code AS product,
  dim_branch.branch_name AS branch,
  COUNT(
    DISTINCT IF(fct_delinquency_daily.dpd >= 30, fct_delinquency_daily.account_key, NULL)
  ) AS delinquent_loans,
  COUNT(
    DISTINCT IF(
      (
        dim_account.account_family = 'LOAN'
      ) AND (
        dim_account.is_open IS TRUE
      ),
      dim_account.account_key,
      NULL
    )
  ) AS open_loans,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(
      DISTINCT IF(fct_delinquency_daily.dpd >= 30, fct_delinquency_daily.account_key, NULL)
    ),
    COUNT(
      DISTINCT IF(
        (
          dim_account.account_family = 'LOAN'
        ) AND (
          dim_account.is_open IS TRUE
        ),
        dim_account.account_key,
        NULL
      )
    )
  ) AS delinquency_rate
FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_delinquency_daily` AS fct_delinquency_daily
JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account` AS dim_account
  ON dim_account.account_key = fct_delinquency_daily.account_key
LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_branch` AS dim_branch
  ON dim_branch.branch_id = dim_account.branch_id
GROUP BY

    ev.*,

      PARTITION BY ev.campaign_id, ev.dispatch_id, ev.cif_number, ev.event_date

WITH detractors AS (
  SELECT
    c.conversation_id,
    c.agent_user_id,
    s.nps_score
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls` AS c
  JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_csat` AS s
    ON c.conversation_id = s.conversation_id
  WHERE c.conversation_date = DATE '2026-05-27'
    AND s.is_detractor
),
latest_wrapup AS (
  SELECT
    seg.conversation_id,
    ARRAY_AGG(seg.wrap_up_code ORDER BY seg.segment_end DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS wrap_up_code_id
  FROM `fennmoor-raw.genesys_cloud.segment` AS seg
  WHERE seg.segment_type = 'wrapup'
    AND seg.wrap_up_code IS NOT NULL
    AND IFNULL(seg._fivetran_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
  GROUP BY seg.conversation_id
),
code_names AS (
  SELECT
    wc.id AS wrapup_code_id,
    ARRAY_AGG(wc.name ORDER BY wc._fivetran_synced DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS wrapup_code_name
  FROM `fennmoor-raw.genesys_cloud.wrapup_code` AS wc
  WHERE IFNULL(wc._fivetran_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
  GROUP BY wc.id
)
SELECT
  d.conversation_id,
  d.agent_user_id,
  d.nps_score,
  cn.wrapup_code_name
FROM detractors AS d
LEFT JOIN latest_wrapup AS lw
  ON d.conversation_id = lw.conversation_id
LEFT JOIN code_names AS cn
  ON lw.wrap_up_code_id = cn.wrapup_code_id

WITH fct_fraud_alerts_1 AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    fraud_type,
    SUM(total_confirmed_fraud_loss) AS total_confirmed_fraud_loss
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC(fct_fraud_alerts.alert_date, MONTH) AS month,
      fct_fraud_alerts.fraud_type AS fraud_type,
      fct_fraud_alerts.alert_id AS per_fct_fraud_alerts_alert_id,
      MAX(fct_fraud_alerts.loss_amount) AS total_confirmed_fraud_loss
    FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_fraud_alerts` AS fct_fraud_alerts
    WHERE
      (
        fct_fraud_alerts.is_confirmed_fraud IS TRUE
      )
    GROUP BY
      1,
      2,
      3
  )
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
), fct_fraud_alerts_2 AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(fct_fraud_alerts.alert_date, MONTH) AS month,
    fct_fraud_alerts.fraud_type AS fraud_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fct_fraud_alerts.alert_id) AS distinct_confirmed_alerts,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_rows,
    MIN(fct_fraud_alerts.loss_amount) AS min_loss_per_alert,
    AVG(fct_fraud_alerts.loss_amount) AS avg_loss_per_alert,
    MAX(fct_fraud_alerts.loss_amount) AS max_loss_per_alert
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_fraud_alerts` AS fct_fraud_alerts
  WHERE
    (
      fct_fraud_alerts.is_confirmed_fraud IS TRUE
    )
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
)

  month,
  fraud_type,
  total_confirmed_fraud_loss AS total_confirmed_fraud_loss,
  distinct_confirmed_alerts AS distinct_confirmed_alerts,
  alert_rows AS alert_rows,
  min_loss_per_alert AS min_loss_per_alert,
  avg_loss_per_alert AS avg_loss_per_alert,
  max_loss_per_alert AS max_loss_per_alert
FROM fct_fraud_alerts_1
FULL JOIN fct_fraud_alerts_2
  USING (month, fraud_type)
ORDER BY
